## Summary

Describe the user-visible or research-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests pass (`python -m pytest -q`).
- [ ] Frontend JavaScript syntax checks pass when web assets changed.
- [ ] New evidence or inference behavior has a focused regression test.
- [ ] No `.env`, API keys, retrieved PDFs, generated search bundles, or caches are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and release notes are updated when applicable.
